sql.sql: SELECT t.name AS TableName,c.name AS ColumnName,c.is_nullable AS IsNullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id=c.object_id WHERE t.name IN ('LopHoc','YeuCauHuyKetNoi') AND c.name IN ('KetThucLuc','CachKetThuc','NguoiPhanHoiId')
